subject: Exploring starter retainer vs consumption for Redwood hosted API
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Minimum monthly spend options for Redwood hosted API

Hi Rachel —

Quick question as we scope our pilot: what are Redwood's minimum monthly spend / commit options for the hosted API? We don't have dedicated capacity budget yet, so we're looking at hosted only.

Our org prefers to start small (proof-of-value) — ideally around $500–$1,000/month — but I want to understand if that tier exists, what the per-token rates would be, and whether any credits / onboarding support are available. Also, do you allow month-to-month pilots or is there a minimum term?

We have standard security and procurement checks; Alicia copied here handles the legal/PO side. Looking to kick off a two-to-four week technical POC as early as September.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of AI Products, AcmeCorp
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Minimum monthly spend options for Redwood hosted API

Hi Sam — great to hear from you, and thanks for the context. Short answer: we can support small pilots on hosted only, and we have two common paths that teams take. Below is a high-level summary — I'll attach the current ratecard for line-item pricing.

1) Consumption (pay-as-you-go)- No monthly minimum.- Standard hosted rates: ~ $0.0012 / 1K prompt tokens, $0.0016 / 1K completion tokens for our curated LLMs (example pricing — see attached for model-by-model).- Suitable if you want zero commit and don't expect sustained throughput.

2) Starter retainer (recommended for predictable pilots)- $1,000 / month (minimum) — 3 month recommended pilot window- Effective blended discounts vs consumption (usually ~10–18% off depending on usage shape) + one-time onboarding credit (up to $1,000) to cover initial eval costs- Comes with a dedicated onboarding session (2 hours) and a shared playbook for batching + caching settings to keep latency/cost predictable

Flexibility notes: we can do a temporary waiver down to $750 / month for strategic pilots if approved by the sales manager and revenue ops — that would be month-to-month for up to 3 months with a 30‑day cancellation window. Overage beyond the retainer is billed at a slightly higher per-token rate (roughly +30% vs retainer units).

Next steps I suggest: (1) confirm target monthly budget (what you expect to consume), (2) pick consumption vs starter retainer, (3) we'll generate PO/DocuSign and add the onboarding credit to the first invoice if applicable.

I've attached: Redwood_Hosted_Ratecard_v2.pdf — contains per-model per-1K token line items and the formal retainer tiers.

If it helps, Ben (cc'd) can also propose a one-page mutual action plan so we can align procurement & security items up front.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Thanks Rachel — that's helpful. Two quick clarifications:

• Can the $750 waiver be used immediately for a 2–3 week technical spike? We'd prefer the lower entry to get engineers aligned.
• If we do the starter retainer, do unused credits roll over to the following month or expire?

Also, our security team will want to see logs and retention options — can you confirm whether hosted customers can get 30 / 90 day request logs and whether there's a standard data retention SLA? Alicia will route the formal questionnaire once we're past pricing.

Appreciate the transparency — Sam

Looping in Monica from RevOps for policy — my recommendation: approve a $750/month starter retainer for AcmeCorp for an initial 3 month window (month-to-month with 30 day cancel). Provide a $750 onboarding credit (applied to month 1). Unused credits do not roll — they expire at the end of the billing month; we can extend in exceptional cases but that's the default. Overage billing at +30% per-token vs retainer units.

Monica — can you confirm we can sign a 3 month pilot at $750 retro today? If not, what's the quickest route?

On the security/logging question: hosted customers can opt into request-level audit logs with 90 day retention (additional fee for longer retention). I'll add the standard SOC2 summary to the doc bundle.

Thanks —
Ben

• Term: up to 3 months, month-to-month with 30-day termination
